page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The lack of bundled local storage represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing pure compute density and network-attached storage configurations over local high-speed disk I/O.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio make this instance suitable for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It is designed for tasks such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive enterprise applications where dedicated CPU performance is critical.
